name: datacite-metadata-toolkit
description: DataCite Metadata Schema (4.6 and 4.7): RDF/JSON-LD vocabulary, JSON Schema profiles, XML-to-JSON conversion, and SKOS/JSKOS/SSSOM crosswalks to Schema.org, DCTERMS, DCAT 3, and Wikidata.

scripts.test:mappings: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/mappings -p 'test_*.py' && node --test tests/mappings/validate.test.js
scripts.validate-profiles: for f in validation-and-conversion/schemas/schema-profiles/*.json validation-and-conversion/schemas/schema-profiles/*.jsonld; do echo "=== $f ==="; npx ajv-cli --strict=false --spec=draft2019 compile -s "$f" || exit 1; done
